sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, promotion_id, order_total FROM order_entry.orders WHERE order_status = 1
SELECT customer_id, promotion_id, SUM(order_total) AS spend FROM order_entry.orders GROUP BY customer_id, promotion_id
SELECT SUM(order_total) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM order_entry.orders WHERE promotion_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_entry.orders GROUP BY warehouse_id
SELECT order_date, SUM(order_total) AS revenue FROM order_entry.orders GROUP BY order_date
SELECT promotion_id, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM order_entry.orders GROUP BY promotion_id
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_entry.orders GROUP BY order_status
